surprises: IRPT_FNTEND-W40-S1: bun test treats a bare (no leading ./) relative path argument that does not match its own test-naming discovery convention as a substring FILTER against already-discovered files, not as an instruction to run that file -- drove this cell's .fixture.ts naming and explicit ./ prefixing on every fixture path.

IRPT_FNTEND-W40-S2: spawnSync called from inside an already-running bun/node process cannot resolve an MSYS-style (/c/...) path directly (ENOENT); the Windows-native forward-slash form resolves and is far faster than routing through bash -lc when a shell is not otherwise needed -- drove this cell's test harness spawning the checker directly with the native path form.
